title: Linear ill-posedness of three-dimensional MHD boundary layer equations
summary: We prove linear ill-posedness in tangential Sobolev spaces for the three-dimensional resistive MHD boundary layer equations. We assume that a suitable linear combination of the initial tangential velocity components has a non-degenerate critical point and that both initial tangential magnetic components have a double zero at the same point. Compared with the corresponding two-dimensional MHD result, our construction requires only this double-zero condition, rather than a higher-order degeneracy of the magnetic shear.
